+      reporter: 'json',

+

+  const { vitestConfig: overridden } = await resolveConfig({
+    changed: 'HEAD',
+    coverage: {
+      changed: false,
+    },
+  })
+
+  expect(overridden.coverage.changed).toBe(false)
+})
